# dsh-source-cnki
**Chinese-literature records: import your export, cite it in GB/T 7714, check the metadata — without
ure records: import your export, cite it in GB/T 7714, check the metadata — without scraping CNKI.**
*No login, no scraping, no CNKI API (none is public for this purpose). The plugin reads RIS/EndNote-
style or labeled text exports, assigns stable record ids, formats GB/T 7714-2015 (顺序编码制) or APA 7, a
nd runs structural validation.*
English · 简体中文
## Scope decision (read first)
CNKI has no public API for this purpose. This plugin therefore **does not** log in, scrape, or bypas
s any access control. You export the records yourself (RIS/EndNote-style tagged text, or labeled tex
t with `题名：`/`作者：`/`来源：`), and the plugin works on that export. If your export lacks a field, the pl
ugin says "missing" — it never invents a journal, year, volume, page range or DOI.
## What it does
- **`cnki_import`** — parses RIS/EndNote-style and labeled text exports, assigns a stable `recordId`
(DOI-based when present, otherwise title+year), detects language, and validates structure. The expo

rt becomes REP evidence when `persist` is on.
- **`cnki_cite`** — GB/T 7714-2015 顺序编码制 (`[1] 作者. 题名[
J]. 刊名, 年, 卷(期): 页码.`), the same without numbering, or APA 7. Author rules: GB/T ≤3 all, otherwise f

irst 3 + `等`/`et al`; Western names become `SURNAME I`; APA becomes `Surname, I.`.
- **`cnki_check`*
* — structural validation: missing title/journal/year/authors, implausible year, malformed DOI, non-
numeric pages, duplicates, journal without volume or issue.
## What it does not do

- **No CNKI access.** No login, no cookies, no scraping, no unofficial endpoints.
- **No content ver
ification.** It does not check that the record matches the real paper; use `dsh-cite-verify` for DOI

s.
- **No semantic fields.** No cited-by counts, impact factors or fund numbers.
- **No DOCX/PDF.**

Export as RIS/labeled text (PDF text extraction: `dsh-doc-anchor`).
- **No claim of GB/T completenes
s.** Variants exist (著者-出版年制, [EB/OL] carriers, [J/OL] with URLs); v0.1 implements the common journa
l/thesis/conference/book cases and says so.
## Formats
| Format | Recognized |
| RIS/EndNote | `TY`, `AU`, `TI`, `JO`, `PY`, `VL`, `IS`, `SP`, `EP`, `DO`, `KW`, `AB`, `ER` (first

tag wins per field, authors accumulate) |
| Labeled text | `题名`/`标题`/`篇名`, `作者`, `来源`/`刊名`, `年`/`发表时
间`, `卷`, `期`, `页码`, `DOI`, `关键词`, `摘要`, `类型`; blank line separates records |
Unknown tags are ignored, not guessed.
## Tools
### `cnki_import`
`{ text? | path?, format?, persist? }` → `{ ok, records, validation, evidenceId?, recordPath? }`.
### `cnki_cite`
`{ records, style?, startIndex? }` → `{ ok, citations, text }`.
### `cnki_check`
`{ records }` → `{ ok, validation }`.
### Error codes
`INVALID_INPUT` · `NOT_FOUND` · `PATH_ESCAPE` · `NOT_A_FILE` · `TOO_LARGE` · `UNSUPPORTED_FILE` · `N
O_RECORDS` · `STORE_ERROR`
## Compatibility & install
/dsh-research-core ^0.1.0`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.5-alpha.1`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepse

ek-ai/schemastery ^3.18.5-alpha.1` |
| Runtime dependencies | **zero** |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | `false` mounts nothing |
| `root` | `.source-cnki` | store/record root |
| `w

orkspaceRoot` | `process.cwd()` | paths must resolve inside it |
| `maxChars` | `2000000` | export c

ap (fails, never truncates) |
| `persist` | `true` | store the export as REP evidence + record |
| `
style` | `gbt7714-numeric` | default citation style |
## Security boundaries

- No network at all: no CNKI, no DOI resolution, no telemetry.
- Read-only on the export; writes onl

y under `root`.
- `realpath` containment; DOCX/PDF rejected with a conversion hint.
- The export is
data. Instruction-like text inside a title or abstract is never executed (there is no executor).
## Evaluation
**23 tests**: RIS and labeled parsing (Chinese and English records, CRLF/BOM exports, DOI-based ids,
language detection), auto-detection and empty/unrecognized rejection, GB/T journal citation with en
-dash pages, ≤3 vs >3 author rules (等 / et al), missing-journal marker, thesis marker, sequential nu
mbering, APA author/year/journal/volume/DOI, validation codes (missing title/journal, implausible ye
ar including far-future dates, malformed DOI, odd pages, duplicates), runtime (valid REP record, cit
e/check, traversal/symlink/DOCX/oversize rejection, malformed records and `null` text rejected), too
l schemas, import→cite→check end to end, failure branches, plugin contract, package contract.
No benchmark is claimed: the ground truth is your export; correctness of the formatter is checked ag
ainst the GB/T rules above with fixtures.
## Known limitations (v0.1)
- GB/T 7714 著者-出版年制, `[J/OL]`/`[EB/OL]` carriers and English journal abbreviation rules are not impl

emented.
- Conference and book records reuse the `journal` field for proceedings/publisher (the expo

rt formats rarely carry separate fields).
- Parsing is line-oriented; deeply wrapped multi-line abst

racts in labeled exports may merge into the previous field.
- No CNKI record id (`CNKI:`/`DBID`) ret
ention beyond what the export contains.
## License
Apache-2.0. No third-party runtime code.
